scope: Controlled SIGTERM interruption and resume under pinned source 0.7.0 on two exact existing local models; separate from formal defense estimates.
acceptance: Each pair starts from clean committed inputs and a fresh offline full-weight lock.
Interrupt only an owned recorder after partial genuine progress; retain actual child/launcher exits and persist the observed progress count before final assessment.
The unchanged scientific command resumes in the same workspace, adds only missing successes, and retains old bytes and originating run IDs.
A separate uninterrupted reference uses the identical per-model scientific identity. Record output/score differences without assuming equality.
All six source captures retain schema 2, pre-child baseline, post-child checks and unverified consumption, including absent optional candidates under clarified Issue #13 semantics.
Source package payload and full local model identity are checked before and after; original formal freezes and installed packages remain unchanged.
Each complete recovered condition and reference contains all 64 unique expected samples; interrupted in-flight work is excluded from completed-response counts.
scheduling: One recovery worker and one reference worker per model on currently available devices. Recheck memory before every launch; use waves if fewer than four suitable allocations are free.
limits: The study script provides resume behavior; ReproLLM supplies actual captures and evidence, not a checkpoint scheduler.
No hard-kill, power failure or corrupted-output repair is claimed.
This is not a new formal defense result, upstream release qualification, five-project acceptance or independent adopter count.
